web.description:
![gpt-oss-120b](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/gpt-oss/main/docs/gpt-oss-120b.svg)

[**Model card**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.10925) ·

- `gpt-oss-120b` — for production, general purpose, high reasoning use cases that fit into a single 80GB GPU (like NVIDIA H100 or AMD MI300X) (117B parameters with 5.1B active parameters)

This model card is dedicated to the larger `gpt-oss-120b` model.

# Highlights
- **Permissive Apache 2.0 license:** Build freely without copyleft restrictions or patent risk—ideal for experimentation, customization, and commercial deployment.
- **MXFP4 quantization:** The models were post-trained with MXFP4 quantization of the MoE weights, making `gpt-oss-120b` run on a single 80GB GPU (like NVIDIA H100 or AMD MI300X) and the `gpt-oss-20b` model run within 16GB of memory. All evals were performed with the same MXFP4 quantization.

# Download the model
```shell
# gpt-oss-120b
huggingface-cli download openai/gpt-oss-120b --include "original/*" --local-dir gpt-oss-120b/
pip install gpt-oss
python -m gpt_oss.chat model/
```

By using gpt-oss, you agree to comply with all applicable law.

## Overview of Capabilities and Architecture
- License: Apache 2.0, with a small complementary use policy.

## Local Inference
### `transformers serve`
```shell
# responses API
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/responses \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{"input": [{"role": "system", "content": "hello"}], "temperature": 1.0, "stream": true, "model": "openai/gpt-oss-120b"}'
```
